review_candidates.description: The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems. CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally. At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work http//www.clintonhealthaccess.org CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture. Position Overview CHAI is seeking a Regional Strategy & Business Development Advisor to lead business development, monitoring, and evaluation (M&E), knowledge management, and cross-country coordination for the West and Central Africa 2 (WCA2) region — Benin, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Mali, and Senegal. The role reports to the Regional Vice President, WCA2, and works closely with the Country Directors and their teams. This is a shared, transversal resource that serves the country teams across WCA2 — not an additional management layer between the Regional Vice President and Country Directors. The support it provides is tailored to each country’s context and program maturity scale-up and innovation support where programs are well established, and more structuring support on the fundamentals where portfolios are smaller or newer, rather than a uniform set of deliverables applied identically across the six countries. The role is open to candidates based in any CHAI program country within the WCA2 region. Because the majority of the region's countries and the Regional Vice President's day-to-day work are conducted in French, full professional fluency in French and English is strongly preferred. Business Development (40%) Lead donor landscaping and prospect research for the region, identifying cross-country and regional funding opportunities aligned to WCA2 priorities. Lead or provide hands-on support for proposal development for regional and multi-country initiatives. Maintain a regional fundraising and pipeline tracker. Conduct donor landscaping to evaluate potential partners aligned to programmatic, regional, and country-level priorities, and generate insights on new strategic partnership opportunities. Translate country program data and field insights into compelling evidence and fundraising narratives for local, regional, and global donors. Lead donor prospect research and prepare high-quality briefings and reports for regional leadership. Monitoring & Evaluation (25%) Build and maintain a regional dashboard of program performance across the six countries, program by program, showing targets, progress achieved, and where support is needed. Support Regional VP WCA2 & Country Director in tracking progress against objectives and key results (OKRs) and regional goals. Feed regional and country performance data into the annual organization-wide goal-setting process. Conduct research on the region’s priority technical areas review of scientific literature, analysis of international guidelines, benchmarking of best practices, consultations with CHAI global and external experts. Knowledge Management (15%) Maintain a country-by-country profile for each of the six countries (what the program does, its potential, and its track record). Map technical expertise across leadership WCA2 team to support mutualization of skills across the region, distinct from operational functions (HR, procurement) where local context and physical presence remain determining. Support capacity building across the region, including the transfer of technical skills to country teams with fewer technical resources. Own the region's knowledge management processes capturing outputs from regional meetings, reviews, and pilots, and keeping them organized and accessible to the whole region. Draft internal communications, memos, and presentations that share learning and align the region. Support the review of the WCA Strategy for the WCA2 region. Cross-Country Coordination (20%) Plan and run the region's regular cross-country touchpoints, including regional brown bags and other structured knowledge-sharing sessions. Support the development of agendas, pre-reads, and materials for regional meetings. Serve as a coordination point between WCA2 and HQ/global teams, including support for the Regional Vice President's engagement with global Vice Presidents and the periodic RVP call with the CEO, COO, and CFO. Master's degree (MBA, MPA, MPP, MPH, or equivalent) required, with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience. Full professional fluency in French and English, spoken and written. Demonstrated experience in proposal development, donor relations, or fundraising, ideally in international development or global health. Experience with program monitoring and evaluation, including building and maintaining performance dashboards or tracking tools. Strong knowledge management skills — organizing, synthesizing, and making information usable for others across a dispersed team. Proven ability to plan and coordinate meetings and initiatives across multiple countries and stakeholders. Strong analytical and written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear materials for senior audiences. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multicultural, and sometimes unstructured environment. High proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. High proficiency in Claude and other AI tools. Experience living and working in a CHAI program country within West or Central Africa strongly preferred. Advantages Prior experience in management consulting, strategy, or regional/global coordination roles. Experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, or security-challenged settings. Familiarity with CHAI's programs and priorities in West and Central Africa. Experience with blended finance and results-based financing mechanisms (e.g. development or social impact bonds, results-based financing). #jobreference2 #jobreference3 #region4

review_candidates.description: Sobre a empresa Somos especializados na criação de superfícies exclusivas Tech-Foil em PP, PET e ASA, bem como na produção de orlas em diversos materiais. Desenvolvemos soluções diferenciadas para a indústria, com foco na qualidade, inovação, confiabilidade e melhoria contínua dos nossos produtos e processos. Pretendemos integrar um Operador de Produção Máquina CAST. Funções: A pessoa selecionada será responsável por monitorizar e ajustar os parâmetros de funcionamento da máquina CAST, realizar o abastecimento de matérias-primas, acompanhar o processo de produção e efetuar verificações de qualidade às bobines produzidas. Terá ainda um papel ativo na validação de matérias-primas, identificação e etiquetagem dos produtos, bem como no apoio a outras áreas do processo produtivo, nomeadamente Corte e Pré-Encolagem. No dia a dia, terá como principais responsabilidades : Monitorizar e ajustar os parâmetros de funcionamento da máquina CAST; Assegurar o abastecimento de matérias-primas à extrusora e à linha de pintura, bem como a preparação das ferramentas necessárias ao processo; Acompanhar o processo produtivo, garantindo a estabilidade e o correto funcionamento dos equipamentos; Realizar testes e inspeções de qualidade às bobines produzidas, verificando características, medidas, acabamento e conformidade com os requisitos definidos; Efetuar a identificação e etiquetagem das bobines produzidas; Validar lotes de matéria-prima em contexto de linha de produção; Registar informações e dados relevantes da produção e reportar desvios, anomalias ou problemas à chefia; Cumprir os procedimentos de segurança, qualidade e boas práticas de produção; Prestar apoio às áreas de Corte e Pré-Encolhagem, sempre que necessário. Requisitos Escolaridade mínima: 12.º ano; Conhecimentos gerais sobre o funcionamento de máquinas industriais, preferencialmente na área de extrusão, CAST ou transformação de materiais plásticos; Experiência em ambiente industrial ou operação de máquinas de produção será valorizada; Sentido de responsabilidade, organização e atenção ao detalhe; Capacidade de trabalho em equipa e boa comunicação; Proatividade, autonomia e vontade de aprender; Compromisso com a qualidade, segurança e cumprimento dos procedimentos; Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial e a tempo inteiro em Santo Tirso. Será valorizada experiência prévia no setor dos plásticos, extrusão, revestimentos ou processos industriais similares.
